summary: Tegafur is an oral prodrug of fluorouracil. It is given either with gimeracil and oteracil (S-1) or with uracil (UFT). Gimeracil and uracil block 5-FU breakdown by DPD; oteracil reduces gut toxicity. S-1 is used for gastric and other GI cancers.
indications: Advanced gastric cancer (S-1, with cisplatin in EU practice)
Colorectal, head and neck and other GI cancers in some regions (S-1 or UFT)

dosage.n: Specialist oncology prescribing only; dose by BSA

dosage.d: Tegafur 300 mg/m2/day in three divided doses, with leucovorin

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Converted in the liver (CYP2A6) to 5-fluorouracil, which inhibits thymidylate synthase and is incorporated into RNA and DNA.

absolute: Brivudine or sorivudine within 4 weeks (fatal 5-FU toxicity)

renal: S-1: reduce dose for CrCl 30 to 50; contraindicated below 30
monitoring: DPD testing before starting where available
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: Supportive; uridine triacetate is the antidote for fluoropyrimidine overdose.
